stories.title: Keja Klaasje Kwestro krijgt toneelprijs Theo d'Or voor F*ck Lolita

en.title: Keja Klaasje Kwestro receives Theo d'Or theatre prize for F*ck Lolita
en.summary: Dutch actress Keja Klaasje Kwestro won the Netherlands' most prestigious theatre award for her lead role in F*ck Lolita, a production by Het Zuidelijk Toneel based on Vladimir Nabokov's controversial 1955 novel.

stories.title: Theo d’Or-winnares Keja Klaasje Kwestro liet de bezoeker in F*CK LOLITA alle hoeken van de theaterzaal zien

en.title: Theo d'Or winner Keja Klaasje Kwestro showed theatre visitors all corners of the hall in F*CK LOLITA
en.summary: Keja Klaasje Kwestro received the Theo d'Or for best lead performance at the Dutch Theatre Gala, where the prestigious VSCD theatre awards were presented.

stories.title: Keja Klaasje Kwestro wint prestigieuze Theo d’Or voor hoofdrol in theaterhit ‘F*ck Lolita’

en.title: Keja Klaasje Kwestro wins prestigious Theo d'Or for lead role in theatre hit 'F*ck Lolita'
en.summary: Dutch actress Keja Klaasje Kwestro won the prestigious Theo d'Or theatre award for her lead role in the theatrical production F*ck Lolita.

stories.title: Prognose: nek-aan-nekrace tussen links en rechts na verkiezingen in Zweden

en.title: Forecast: neck-and-neck race between left and right after elections in Sweden
en.summary: Latest polling for Sweden's Riksdag election shows the right-wing bloc holding power with 174 of 349 seats, while the left-wing opposition trails narrowly with 175 projected seats.

stories.title: Minimaal verschil bij Zweedse verkiezingen: linkse oppositie in prognose één zetel meer dan rechts blok

en.title: Minimal difference in Swedish elections: left-wing opposition predicted one seat more than right-wing bloc
en.summary: Swedish election projections show the left-wing opposition ahead of the right-wing bloc by a single seat, indicating a closely contested election result.

stories.title: Voor het eerst sinds 2014 heeft Spanje weer een Vuelta-winnaar: Enric Mas

en.title: For the first time since 2014, Spain has a Vuelta winner again: Enric Mas
en.summary: Enric Mas has won the Vuelta, marking Spain's first victory in the race since 2014.

en.summary: Kimi Antonelli won the Madrid race, with Max Verstappen finishing in second place.

en.title: Video | Ukraine and Poland warn Europe after Russian attack near border
en.summary: Ukraine and Poland have issued warnings to Europe following a Russian military attack near their border region.

stories.title: Turkse regering doet invallen en arrestaties bij lhbti+-gemeenschap

en.title: Turkish government conducts raids and arrests in LGBTQ+ community
en.summary: Turkish authorities arrested nearly 50 activists and are pursuing legal procedures against 162 individuals and 22 organizations. The operation represents an escalation in the repression of LGBTQ+ people in Turkey.

stories.title: Een hete en droge zomer vol records, maar het kabinet van premier Jetten (ooit klimaatminister) houdt zich stil. Vier verklaringen waarom

en.title: A hot and dry summer full of records, but Prime Minister Jetten's cabinet (once climate minister) remains silent. Four explanations why
en.summary: Despite record-breaking heat and drought conditions, the Dutch cabinet led by former climate advocate Rob Jetten has refrained from public commentary, largely for political reasons.

stories.title: Bijna geen last gehad van muggenbulten of gezoem? Minder muggen in droge en hete zomer

en.title: Hardly bothered by mosquito bites or buzzing? Fewer mosquitoes in dry and hot summer
en.summary: The Netherlands experienced relatively low mosquito nuisance this summer compared to previous years, according to data from Wageningen University's Muggenradar project. The mosquito nuisance index was 16 percent lower than historical averages.

stories.title: Muggen hadden last van zeer droge en hete zomer: 'Zesde generatie vliegt rond'

en.title: Mosquitoes suffered from very dry and hot summer: 'Sixth generation flying around'
en.summary: Researchers from Wageningen University attribute fewer mosquitoes during the summer to extreme drought and high temperatures that disrupted the insects' breeding cycles.
